title: Duskveil moves to the Sunscar
changes: Duskveil, the Veiled capital, now stands in the Saffron Dunes of the Sunscar, below the Thornspire and east of Mirage Wells. Its west gate opens onto the paved Sunscar Highway to Mirage Wells, and its south gate onto a dirt road west along the dunes.
Gate wardens turn away heroes under level 5, heroes at war with the Veiled and heroes Wanted by them. The city's waystone keeps the same rules.
The old waygate to Duskveil is gone.
